titleEn: Minimum Time to Visit a Cell In a Grid
title: 在网格图中访问一个格子的最少时间
summary: 从左上角出发，每秒必须移动到相邻格；只有当前时间达到格子的开放时间才能进入，求到右下角的最早时刻。
insight: 离开起点后可沿刚走过的边来回移动，以两秒为单位等待。因此从时刻 t 走向门槛 g 的最早到达时刻，是不小于 g 且与 t+1 同奇偶性的数。边的有效代价依赖当前时刻但保持先进先出，可用 Dijkstra。起点若在第一秒没有可达邻居则无法开始等待。
pitfalls: 若起点所有邻居开放时间都大于一要立即返回 -1
跨过门槛时要按奇偶性补一秒
距离出堆后过期状态应跳过

solutions.title: 带奇偶等待的 Dijkstra
solutions.idea: 把每个格子视为节点，按最早可进入时间松弛相邻节点。
steps: 特判单格网格与起点在第一秒无法离开的情况
弹出当前最早格子，枚举四邻
candidate=t+1；若小于邻格门槛，则提升到门槛以上且保持 candidate 的奇偶性
用 candidate 松弛距离并入堆
首次弹出终点时返回时间

code.java: class Solution { public int minimumTime(int[][] grid){int rows=grid.length,cols=grid[0].length;if(rows==1&&cols==1)return 0;boolean canLeave=rows>1&&grid[1][0]<=1||cols>1&&grid[0][1]<=1;if(!canLeave)return -1;int[][] distance=new int[rows][cols];for(int[] row:distance)Arrays.fill(row,Integer.MAX_VALUE);PriorityQueue<int[]> queue=new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingInt(a->a[0]));distance[0][0]=0;queue.offer(new int[]{0,0,0});int[] directions={-1,0,1,0,-1};while(!queue.isEmpty()){int[] current=queue.poll();int time=current[0],row=current[1],col=current[2];if(time!=distance[row][col])continue;if(row==rows-1&&col==cols-1)return time;for(int d=0;d<4;d++){int nextRow=row+directions[d],nextCol=col+directions[d+1];if(nextRow<0||nextRow>=rows||nextCol<0||nextCol>=cols)continue;int nextTime=time+1,required=grid[nextRow][nextCol];if(nextTime<required)nextTime=required+((required-nextTime)&1);if(nextTime<distance[nextRow][nextCol]){distance[nextRow][nextCol]=nextTime;queue.offer(new int[]{nextTime,nextRow,nextCol});}}}return -1;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minimumTime(grid:Array<IntArray>):Int{val rows=grid.size;val cols=grid[0].size;if(rows==1&&cols==1)return 0;val canLeave=rows>1&&grid[1][0]<=1||cols>1&&grid[0][1]<=1;if(!canLeave)return -1;val distance=Array(rows){IntArray(cols){Int.MAX_VALUE}};val queue=java.util.PriorityQueue<IntArray>(compareBy<IntArray>{it[0]});distance[0][0]=0;queue.offer(intArrayOf(0,0,0));val directions=intArrayOf(-1,0,1,0,-1);while(queue.isNotEmpty()){val current=queue.poll();val time=current[0];val row=current[1];val col=current[2];if(time!=distance[row][col])continue;if(row==rows-1&&col==cols-1)return time;for(d in 0 until 4){val nextRow=row+directions[d];val nextCol=col+directions[d+1];if(nextRow !in 0 until rows||nextCol !in 0 until cols)continue;var nextTime=time+1;val required=grid[nextRow][nextCol];if(nextTime<required)nextTime=required+((required-nextTime) and 1);if(nextTime<distance[nextRow][nextCol]){distance[nextRow][nextCol]=nextTime;queue.offer(intArrayOf(nextTime,nextRow,nextCol))}}};return -1} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int minimumTime(vector<vector<int>>& grid){int rows=grid.size(),cols=grid[0].size();if(rows==1&&cols==1)return 0;bool canLeave=(rows>1&&grid[1][0]<=1)||(cols>1&&grid[0][1]<=1);if(!canLeave)return -1;vector<vector<int>> distance(rows,vector<int>(cols,INT_MAX));priority_queue<array<int,3>,vector<array<int,3>>,greater<array<int,3>>> queue;distance[0][0]=0;queue.push({0,0,0});int directions[5]={-1,0,1,0,-1};while(!queue.empty()){auto [time,row,col]=queue.top();queue.pop();if(time!=distance[row][col])continue;if(row==rows-1&&col==cols-1)return time;for(int d=0;d<4;++d){int nextRow=row+directions[d],nextCol=col+directions[d+1];if(nextRow<0||nextRow>=rows||nextCol<0||nextCol>=cols)continue;int nextTime=time+1,required=grid[nextRow][nextCol];if(nextTime<required)nextTime=required+((required-nextTime)&1);if(nextTime<distance[nextRow][nextCol]){distance[nextRow][nextCol]=nextTime;queue.push({nextTime,nextRow,nextCol});}}}return -1;} };
